Nadia, Gideon landed on 280 seats for Vantorre Group. I replied in your thread in #strategic-pod with the same answer.

His July 1 update first said 300. About ten minutes later he corrected it. The 300 included sandbox logins from the May rollout, and the production roster showed 280 active seats. Ruth acknowledged the 280, so use that for your roster sheet.
